# The Dwarf Era — Narrative Script

*Audio: 15_The_Dwarf_Era.mp3 — August 2, 2026*

---

When the dragon empires fell, the dwarves rose from beneath the world.

They had been there all along — burrowing through mountains, refining ore, perfecting craft. But with the sky empty of wings, the deep places of Ge'or opened into something the world had never seen: underground megacities. Dwarvengor. Coalsteel. The halls of the Diamonds Kingdom, lit by forge-fire, fed by the Romanium ore that ran beneath the continents like veins of liquid wealth.

Romanium made them. For a thousand years, dwarven smiths mass-produced weapons, tools, and commodities for the entire known world. An empire of industry — precision and perfection in a medieval age. Their beards grew long, their pride grew longer, and their golden halls overflowed with the wealth of nations.

But the ore was finite. When the Romanium ran out, the dwarven economy collapsed over centuries. The mines went silent. The megacities dimmed. The world that had depended on dwarven steel found other hands to forge it — human hands, elven hands, hands that had never touched a forge.

The Dwarf Era ended not with a war, but with an empty mine shaft.

And the Iron Age began.
